content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I would appreciate your help. I installed [product_name] [version_no] and I'm having trouble simulating my [product_name] controller in [product_name] Advanced. The device has termination [article_no], firmware [version_no], and I also have another controller with termination [article_no]. I can program this second one in [product_name] Web Editor, and have verified all physical connections and IP addresses—they are not the same. I upload the program to the controller, go online, start runtime on my laptop, but the values do not show up, and in some tables I only see placeholders like ####. Could anyone assist me? Thank you. Did you set up the connection configuration in [product_name] Advanced? If you can share some screenshots of your setup, it would help us understand what you've done so far. Thanks.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing difficulties establishing communication between [product_name] controllers and [product_name] Advanced within [product_name] [version_no] on Windows 10 Home. Even after confirming physical setup and IP addresses, live values fail to display during runtime, causing confusion and hindering monitoring or control via the HMI. The feedback provided by the system, such as placeholder characters, does not help users diagnose the issue, indicating that connection configuration in [product_name] Advanced may require clearer guidance.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that once [product_name] controllers are properly configured and connected with [product_name] and [product_name] Advanced, all live process values should appear during runtime without unexpected errors or further complicated configuration, allowing for simple monitoring and control.
